facts.fact: The WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement database record, from Seychelles' own extension request, says the Seychelles Revenue Commission runs ASYCUDA World (version 4.3.2), enhanced from September 2021 to May 2024 with express courier, manifest, excise bonded warehouse and tariff modules.

SYC.note: The single window is not in service: preliminary work has started and the deadline is 30 June 2027, so no window fact.
No government payments to people stated.

No mobile money or retail payment service stated.

facts.fact: The WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement database record, from Seychelles' extension request, lists an electronic payment (E-Payment) module among the completed additions to the Seychelles Revenue Commission's ASYCUDA World customs system.
